pages.text: $(item)Rowboats$() wait, tied up, along the world's coasts, and anyone can row one. Take the $(item)rowing bench$(): $(k:forward) and $(k:back) row, $(k:left) and $(k:right) turn. Some carry a cannon or a harpoon gun.
Use the $(item)rowboat hook$() beside your ship's ladder to tie a rowboat on; she's towed wherever the ship goes.
